name: Reentrancy (Solidity)
attack_scenario: a low-level call forwarding Ether hands control to the recipient, whose fallback re-enters withdraw() before the caller zeroes the balance, so the balance check passes repeatedly and the contract is drained in one transaction (SWC-107, The DAO)
negative_test_hint: deploy an attacker contract whose "receive() re-enters withdraw" and assert the second entry reverts and the balance cannot be drained twice

exemplar.explanation: zero the balance BEFORE sending (checks-effects-interactions) and add a nonReentrant guard; a re-entering fallback then sees a zeroed balance and cannot double-withdraw
